title: Copy files using a specific SSH key
summary: If you have multiple SSH keys or need to use a specific private key for authentication, use the -i flag with scp to point to the correct key file.
prerequisites: Path to your SSH private key file

steps.explain: Use the -i flag to specify the path to the SSH private key for authentication.

placeholders.name: PRIVATE_KEY
placeholders.description: Path to your SSH private key file

placeholders.name: LOCAL_FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the file on your computer

placeholders.name: REMOTE_HOST
placeholders.description: Hostname or IP of the remote computer

placeholders.name: REMOTE_FILE
placeholders.description: Destination path on the remote computer
